备注：Figure 6 footnotes retain missing/low-abundance peptide observations at individual replicate level.

备注：Page 24 sample preparation used 2.5 μL La antigen (2 μg/μL), 15.5 μL of 10 mM test-compound stock, dilution to 310 μL with 20 mM Tris pH 8.0, and 1 h at 37 °C before 50 mM IAD treatment.

备注：Figure 6 caption reports compounds at 50 mM final concentration, whereas the page-24 charge/dilution corresponds arithmetically to 0.5 mM; both source statements are retained without choosing one.

备注：Page 25 reports a minimum precursor signal of 5000 and HCD analysis at normalized collision energy 35 V, isolation width 2, and first mass m/z 100.00. Each sample was run in technical triplicate and analyzed independently; peptide identification required all or all but one expected y ions and at least two b ions.
